scope.proof_kind: Actual current source review; remote primary exact-pin Zoom and View3D registration source. No new host/native behavior execution.

decision.preferred: B: after an actually selected ordinary native navigation keymap match and successful genuine native poll, before operator allocation, with fresh exact same-context live Knife proof.
decision.rejected_minimal_A: Positive physical MOUSEPAN plus native Knife modal is insufficient for current pane/UI/native intent. Native modal dispatch forcibly rehosts context to original Knife area, even for cursor input in another pane, before ordinary editor UI is tried. Bare consumption steals unrelated/custom input.
decision.not_implementation_ready: B needs a concrete compatibility contract for the actual chosen ordinary map/item, native Zoom callback profile/no-Python poll, fresh strict owner and a pure native mode query. Source proves a smaller panning-state seam can preserve actual custom Knife PAN->PANNING without a full canonical modal map inventory. Connected actual-source controls remain unexecuted.
decision.policy_limit: A B policy would deny a current stock navigation attempt while a fresh same-context native Knife exists. It proves neither accepted initial DOWN nor that this physical contact originally started or owned that Knife. Value-identical customization history is indistinguishable and must be explicitly inside any stock-value policy; arbitrary custom intent cannot be inferred.

actual_trace.fact: Ordinary Pencil Began emits CURSOR_MOVE then LEFT_BUTTON_DOWN at recognized current location; translation is cached before reading relative translation. Changed emits paired PAN_GESTURE then CURSOR_MOVE; only Changed with physical pencilContactDown sets physical_pencil_precision_pan. Existing live-owner omission freezes at recognizeKnifePan; nohandler/samebatch remains fallback.

Exact positive GHOST scalar/subtype/one-finger grants WM class. Merge AND retains class only if every merged input was positive. Class does not contain contact serial, accepted press, original window/region or owner.

For each queued event WM derives area/region under current xy, runs whole window modal list first, then iPad panel service, then visually chosen area/region native handlers. Native routing never predicts the selected tool's eventual DOWN behavior.
Default region handlers register UI, gizmos, then dynamic toolsystem handler. Actual handler list execution and polls still decide whether any initial DOWN reaches the tool map.

Actual dynamic toolsystem resolves area's current runtime keymap/fallback list from userconf. WM_event_get_keymaps_from_handler returns dynamic maps or active current static map; active tool name itself grants no operator dispatch.

Knife tool map binds tool_mouse PRESS to mesh.knife_tool with wait_for_input=False; default PRESS does not admit arbitrary modifiers under native wm_eventmatch. Modified/custom initial DOWN is not proof of Knife creation.

Actual keymap poll and wm_eventmatch select kmi; wm_handler_operator_call resolves actual type and tool properties; genuine operator poll precedes allocation, and invoke receives a fresh copy with region mval.

Only after native invoke runs does Knife allocate/init its actual context, reject only-selected with no faces, set modal-cursor-region, call WM_event_add_modal_handler, optionally dispatch actual ADD_CUT, and return RUNNING_MODAL.

WM records actual registration area/region, inserts modal handler and binds callback-free registered native Knife owner tuple/lifetimes. This may happen while earlier DOWN in same native queue is processed; later PAN then sees the actual live owner. No original physical contact ownership follows.

Native modal dispatch saves current hovered area/region, then replaces context with handler origin. OP_IS_MODAL_CURSOR_REGION may retarget a WINDOW only inside that original area; otherwise saved original region is used. Modal callback runs after modal-map translation. PASS_THROUGH restores prior hovered context.

Knife resets transient MODE_PANNING to prevmode at each modal entry. Native mapped PANNING sets mode and returns PASS_THROUGH; un-mapped MOUSEPAN/ZOOM/ROTATE/wheel/NDOF return PASS_THROUGH. A check after resetting mode cannot use MODE_PANNING as prior deliberate-navigation intent proof.

On PASS modal mapping is restored to original type/value, status returns CONTINUE, and ordinary processing uses visual region under current cursor. Thus custom modal PAN->PANNING is indistinguishable from un-mapped PAN to a later consumer unless modal compatibility or an actual-dispatch scalar is proved.
The static native 3D View Generic and 3D View maps are added last, allowing tool/mode handlers to override. Primary exact-pin view3d_ops.cc:255-260 merely ensures both maps without custom map poll.

MMB-pan preference swaps plain/Shift TRACKPADPAN rotate/move. Both modes retain Ctrl TRACKPADPAN zoom. Ctrl+Shift/Alt/OSKey modifiers require actual matching; do not infer Ctrl bit alone is stock zoom intent.
Current Apple wrapper returns FINISHED for MOUSEPAN without two/three-finger flags, before ViewOpsData allocation. Plain/Shift ordinary single-Pencil move route already causes no view mutation.
Current Apple wrapper returns FINISHED for MOUSEPAN without two-finger flag. Ordinary single-Pencil rotate route already causes no view mutation in both MMB preference modes.

Exact pinned primary source MOUSEPAN invokes zoom immediately (including camera-lock/autokey paths) and returns FINISHED. Registration exposes static invoke/exec, common native modal/cancel, and view3d_zoom_or_dolly_poll. This unmodified file is absent from the 138-file materialization and was read through GitHub connector.

Exact inventory: only KNF_MODAL_PANNING and raw navigation switch return PASS inside knifetool_modal. Wrapper PASS at4679 is invalid private action admission, not ordinary modal. PANNING action=15; KM_RELEASE=2/NOTHING=0. Actual PANNING branch compares mapped event->val=15 (not prev_val), so it leaves MODE_PANNING after any successfully mapped PANNING, including a raw RELEASE. Every other mapped action terminates or returns RUNNING_MODAL, breaking ordinary dispatch. At positive ordinary raw PAN val0 reaching nav, a freshly read native mode==PANNING is therefore explicit mapped delegation and must keep fallback. Raw un-mapped PAN resets prior PANNING before PASS, so old MMB mode alone is not a false current delegation.

counterexamples.case: Cross-pane physical PAN while Knife lives in area A
counterexamples.A: Knife modal receives event with context forced to A even if original hovered area is B. Bare positive-class consumption swallows B navigation/scroll.
counterexamples.B: Actual chosen native 3D handler context is B. Strict fresh owner capture with area B fails or original owner region differs, so fallback.

counterexamples.case: Quad-view different WINDOW in same area
counterexamples.A: OP_IS_MODAL_CURSOR_REGION can alter handler->context.region within same area while kcd vc original region remains A. Local modal context is not equivalent to original-owner match.
counterexamples.B: Require actual chosen region equal fresh registered Knife original region. Other quad-view remains fallback.

counterexamples.A: Window modal Knife runs before ordinary editor UI; rect inclusion inside Knife region alone is not UI membership.
counterexamples.B: Only an actual region's static stock nav candidate is eligible after existing priorities. Direct/gizmo/area/window/delegated calls carry no private dispatch grant. This is semantic chosen-dispatch membership, not completed exposed-pixel proof.

counterexamples.A: Un-mapped MOUSEPAN-only check after native translation preserves EVT_MODAL_MAP. Blanket flag check before mapping does not.
counterexamples.B: A smaller source-backed refinement is available: after restoring actual raw PAN val0, a pure native fresh Knife mode query can exclude MODE_PANNING, because PANNING is the sole mapped PASS path and always stores that mode. This preserves custom PAN->PANNING, without a full canonical modal map table. Other mapped actions break ordinary dispatch. Do not read pre-modal/stale mode.

counterexamples.A: Early modal consumption never sees actual ordinary kmi, properties, map or route.
counterexamples.B: Must grant only validated current stock-value item/map, exact flags/properties/modifiers and static region handler identity; changed/custom/direct routes keep fallback. Native function name alone is insufficient.

counterexamples.case: Nohandler, rejected native poll, custom initial DOWN, or replacement Knife
counterexamples.A: Class does not prove DOWN acceptance or native owner identity.
counterexamples.B: Read the actually registered current native owner; no owner means no denial. Fresh current-owner denial can cover samebatch actual native registration, but must never be called proof the original DOWN owned it.

counterexamples.A: Knife-only branch could preserve them but only if actual caller truly native Knife.
counterexamples.B: No current sole native Knife owner means no policy grant. Existing exact-source characterization radius25->31/propsize2->2.2 must remain; no producer omission/order change.

minimum_B_contract: Private dispatch grant is minted only at actual matched stock ordinary keymap/item in actual WINDOW's region handler list; never derive from tool name, numeric MOUSEPAN type, operator idname alone, or a future predicted match.

Eligible visible failure can initially be only exact Ctrl-only KM_NOTHING positive ordinary physical Pencil MOUSEPAN -> stock VIEW3D_OT_zoom; plain/Shift rotate/move already filtered. Other modifier/finger/direct/cancel/pinch/keymodifier classes fallback.

Preserve custom modal delegation through a pure native fresh Knife mode query after actual native modal dispatch: MODE_PANNING retains fallback. Exact source proves PANNING is the sole mapped PASS path, mapped action15 differs from KM_RELEASE2, raw val0 is restored, and all other mapped actions cannot reach ordinary nav. This read must follow strict actual registered owner validation; no retained pointer or accepted-DOWN inference. It is a source contract, not executed fixture proof.

Validate actual ordinary map provenance/value policy, no dynamic/poll/post/custom-tool handler callbacks, current stock kmi raw values/IDs/properties. Whole-map versus bounded-item policy needs explicit review; matching stock text or no user-modified flag is not sufficient evidence.

Native Zoom type proof must cover exact invoke/exec/modal/cancel/poll, flags, empty macro, null pyop_poll and null RNA extension callbacks, before and after genuine WM_operator_poll. No-Python context avoids CTX WM overrides. Native zoom poll is callback-free native region-view membership and lock-bit inspection; source-backed getters are required.

After native poll, reacquire current context/owner with existing strict WM_ipad_knife_owner_capture and require WM_ipad_knife_owner_region equal actual selected region. No retained handler/op/context pointer may be trusted across arbitrary callbacks; no new replacement Cancel, terminal, press or lease.

Return consumed native cancellation before wm_operator_create/ViewOpsData allocation for this denied attempt only, like current Node denial architecture. Preserve packets/order, native modal histories, type/owner lifecycle and all existing guards.

Connected current-source/O0/O2 characterization must cover samebatch actual DOWN invocation/binding -> PAN modal-pass -> restore -> actual map/poll/preallocation, crosspane/quad/UI/custommodal/customordinary, both MMB preference modes, Circle/Transform/directnav/multifinger/hardware/deniedpoll/type replacement. Source-only design is not a passed fixture.

Conservative alternative if a future source changes the PASS/mode proof: reject any active modal binding that can match this actual raw PAN, using genuine wm_eventmatch semantics and no callbacks. A whole fixed Knife-modal inventory is unnecessary for the current two-PASS source, but no future general-mode equivalence may be assumed.
